div.head: I Atr 4.3
div.ab: ⁊ se þe þys forsytte ⁊ hit geforðian nylle, swa ure ealra cwide is, sylle þam cynge CXX scll.'
⁊ se ðe ðis forsitte ⁊ hit geforðian nylle, swa ure ealra cwide is, sylle ðam cynge hundtwelftig scill.
Et qui supersederit et paruipendet uel complere nolet, sicut omnium nostrum est institutum, emendet regi CXX sol.
⁊ se ðe þis forsitte ⁊ hit geforðian nylle, swa ure ealra cwide is, sylle ðam cynge hundtwelftig scill'.
And he who ignores this, and will not further what we have all decreed, shall pay 120 shillings to the king.
Und wer dies vernachlässigt und es, wie unser aller Beschluss ist, zu fördern weigert, zahle dem König 120 Schill. [Strafe].
And whoever neglects this and refuses to further it, as is the decision of us all, let him pay the king 120 shillings [as a fine].
div.note: In H, ‘Willelmes cyninges asetnysse’ on modes of proof follows; in B, French verses written in the early 13th c.; in Quadr., III Atr. Liebermann compares IV As 7.
